datasheet_identity.title: MMSZ5221B THRU MMSZ5267B Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes

extraction_notes: The supplied PDF SHA-256 matches the expected digest fec00843f279bccf78d55a456b749bf49d99676181d710880c28c93d8ee35181.
The MMSZ5225B row specifies VZ minimum 2.85 V, nominal 3.0 V, and maximum 3.15 V at IZT = 20 mA, maximum ZZT = 30 ohm, maximum IR = 50 uA at VR = 1.0 V, all at Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.
The zener curve points are manual digitizations of the real curve labelled 3.0 in p. 3 Fig. 1; no interpolated or synthesized points were added.
The capacitance plot in p. 4 Fig. 5 is a generic family characteristic and does not provide an unambiguous MMSZ5225B-specific scalar capacitance value for the strict schema.
Reverse recovery is omitted because the datasheet publishes no trr or switching-time specification.
Zener knee sharpness is not extractable from the supplied table because ZZK at IZK is not published; only maximum ZZT is provided.
